# Old Dominion University Computer Science Department

> The CS Department at Old Dominion University provides comprehensive academic programs, research opportunities, IT infrastructure support, and community engagement through seminars and web archiving tools.

ODU's Computer Science Department offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs (BS, MS, PhD) with research strengths in cybersecurity and systems. The department maintains dedicated IT support services for faculty, staff, and students across its Norfolk, VA campus.

## Key Topics

- Computer Science Department
- Old Dominion University
- Graduate Programs
- Undergraduate Programs

- [Computer Science Department Home](https://www.cs.odu.edu/): ODU CS Dept: BS, MS, PhD programs, research labs, cybersecurity

## IT Systems & Support

- [Systems Group IT Support](https://systems.cs.odu.edu): Systems Group IT support for CS dept: VPN, Linux servers, accounts, help resources

- [CS Department Colloquia](https://www.cs.odu.edu/~zeil/colloq.html): CS Department colloquium schedule and academic seminars calendar

## Research Tools & Resources

- [Carbon Dating The Web](https://carbondate.cs.odu.edu/): Carbon Dating The Web: temporal analysis tool for webpage archiving and web history research
